name: @fora/console-js
description: Lint and tests for the publisher console's browser scripts, which are served as they are from ../internal/web/static.

scripts.lint: biome check --error-on-warnings . ../internal/web/static && npm run lint:promises && npm run cycles
scripts.lint:promises: cd .. && oxlint -A all --type-aware -D no-floating-promises internal/web/static js/tests
